# Journalism Web Scraping v2.0.10

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on functions that easily download data or files from the web.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-web-scraping/v2.0.10/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [downloadFile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-web-scraping/v2.0.10/docs/functions/downloadFile.md): downloadFile function
- [getHtmlTable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-web-scraping/v2.0.10/docs/functions/getHtmlTable.md): getHtmlTable function
- [getStatCanTable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-web-scraping/v2.0.10/docs/functions/getStatCanTable.md): getStatCanTable function
